Script.name: MSDP Gauges
Script.script: function GUI.updateHealthGauge() GUI.debug("GUI/GAUGE/HEALTH", "update requested", { health = msdp and msdp.HEALTH, maximum = msdp and msdp.HEALTH_MAX, gauge = type(GUI.Health), }) -- This function handles the following events: -- msdp.HEALTH -- msdp.HEALTH_MAX -- Check if gauge exists if not GUI.Health then return end -- Get values with defaults local health = tonumber(msdp.HEALTH) or 0 local max_health = tonumber(msdp.HEALTH_MAX) or 1 -- Calculate percentage local pct_health if health > max_health then health = max_health end if max_health > 0 then pct_health = (health / max_health) * 100 else pct_health = 0 end -- Update display local displayText = "HEALTH: " .. health .. "/" .. max_health .. "" GUI.Health.front:echo([[]] .. displayText .. [[]]) GUI.Health.back:echo([[]] .. displayText .. [[]]) -- Set gauge value if pct_health > 100 then GUI.Health:setValue(100, 100) else GUI.Health:setValue(pct_health, 100) end if GUI.Sound then GUI.Sound.checkThreshold("low_health", health, max_health) end end function GUI.updateMovesGauge() GUI.debug("GUI/GAUGE/MOVEMENT", "update requested", { movement = msdp and msdp.MOVEMENT, maximum = msdp and msdp.MOVEMENT_MAX, gauge = type(GUI.Moves), }) -- This function handles the following events: -- msdp.MOVEMENT -- msdp.MOVEMENT_MAX -- Check if gauge exists if not GUI.Moves then return end -- Get values with defaults local moves = tonumber(msdp.MOVEMENT) or 0 local max_moves = tonumber(msdp.MOVEMENT_MAX) or 1 -- Calculate percentage local pct_moves if max_moves > 0 then pct_moves = (moves / max_moves) * 100 else pct_moves = 0 end -- Update display local displayText = "MOVES: " .. moves .. "/" .. max_moves .. "" GUI.Moves.front:echo([[]] .. displayText .. [[]]) GUI.Moves.back:echo([[]] .. displayText .. [[]]) -- Set gauge value if pct_moves > 100 then GUI.Moves:setValue(100, 100) else GUI.Moves:setValue(pct_moves, 100) end if GUI.Sound then GUI.Sound.checkThreshold("low_moves", moves, max_moves) end end -- function GUI.updateExperienceGauge() -- -- This function handles the following events: -- -- msdp.EXPERIENCE -- -- msdp.EXPERIENCE_TNL -- -- -- Check if gauge exists -- if not GUI.Experience then -- return -- end -- -- -- Get values with defaults -- local xp = tonumber(msdp.EXPERIENCE) or 0 -- local xp_tnl = tonumber(msdp.EXPERIENCE_TNL) or 0 -- -- -- Calculate percentage -- local pct_xp -- local total_xp = xp + xp_tnl -- if total_xp > 0 then -- pct_xp = (xp / total_xp) * 100 -- else -- pct_xp = 0 -- end -- -- -- Update display with dynamic font sizes -- local gaugeHeight = GUI.Experience:get_height() -- local fontSize1 = math.max(8, math.floor(gaugeHeight * 0.4)) -- local fontSize2 = math.max(6, math.floor(gaugeHeight * 0.3)) -- local displayText = "EXP: " .. xp .. "/" .. total_xp .. "" -- GUI.Experience.front:echo([[]] .. displayText .. [[]]) -- GUI.Experience.back:echo([[]] .. displayText .. [[]]) -- -- -- Set gauge value -- if pct_xp > 100 then -- GUI.Experience:setValue(100, 100) -- else -- GUI.Experience:setValue(pct_xp, 100) -- end -- end function GUI.updatePSPGauge() GUI.debug("GUI/GAUGE/PSP", "update requested", { psp = msdp and msdp.PSP, maximum = msdp and msdp.PSP_MAX, gauge = type(GUI.PSP), }) -- This function handles the following events: -- msdp.PSP -- msdp.PSP_MAX -- Check if gauge exists if not GUI.PSP then return end -- Get values with defaults local psp = tonumber(msdp.PSP) or 0 local max_psp = tonumber(msdp.PSP_MAX) or 1 -- Calculate percentage local pct_psp if max_psp > 0 then pct_psp = (psp / max_psp) * 100 else pct_psp = 0 end -- Update display local displayText = "PSP: " .. psp .. "/" .. max_psp .. "" GUI.PSP.front:echo([[]] .. displayText .. [[]]) GUI.PSP.back:echo([[]] .. displayText .. [[]]) -- Set gauge value if pct_psp > 100 then GUI.PSP:setValue(100, 100) else GUI.PSP:setValue(pct_psp, 100) end end function GUI.updateEnemyGauge() GUI.debug("GUI/GAUGE/ENEMY", "update requested", { opponentName = msdp and msdp.OPPONENT_NAME, health = msdp and msdp.OPPONENT_HEALTH, maximum = msdp and msdp.OPPONENT_HEALTH_MAX, gauge = type(GUI.Enemy), }) -- This function handles the following events: -- msdp.OPPONENT_HEALTH -- msdp.OPPONENT_HEALTH_MAX -- msdp.OPPONENT_NAME -- Check if gauge exists if not GUI.Enemy then return end -- Get opponent name local opponent_name = msdp.OPPONENT_NAME or "" -- Show/Hide the gauge based on opponent presence if opponent_name == "" then GUI.Enemy:hide() return else GUI.Enemy:show() end -- Get values with defaults local health = tonumber(msdp.OPPONENT_HEALTH) or 0 local max_health = tonumber(msdp.OPPONENT_HEALTH_MAX) or 1 -- Calculate percentage local pct_health if max_health > 0 then pct_health = (health / max_health) * 100 else pct_health = 0 end -- Update display local displayText = "" .. opponent_name:upper() .. ": " .. health .. "/" .. max_health .. "" GUI.Enemy.front:echo(displayText) GUI.Enemy.back:echo(displayText) -- Set gauge value if pct_health > 100 then GUI.Enemy:setValue(100, 100) else GUI.Enemy:setValue(pct_health, 100) end end
